voice.error: Sorry, something went wrong on our side. Please call again in a little while.
voice.unknown_ref: Sorry, I couldn't save your details just now. Please call again in a little while.
voice.consent_required: No problem. Without your consent to AI calls we can't register you. Thank you!
voice.registered: Our team will check your ID, and then you'll start getting jobs.
voice.already_registered: You're already registered with Suvidha. We'll call you when a job comes up.
voice.open_job_draft: We've sent you a question on WhatsApp about your {trade} job; please answer it there.
voice.open_job_inviting: We're collecting rates from workers for your {trade} job and will send them on WhatsApp.
voice.open_job_quotes: We've sent the rates for your job on WhatsApp; please pick a worker there.
voice.open_job_booked: {trade} {worker} will do your job, arriving by about {eta}.

whatsapp.ask_trade: Which worker do you need: carpenter, plumber or electrician?
whatsapp.ask_job_type: What job do you need done? Tell us in one line.
whatsapp.ask_problem: What's the problem? Tell us in one line.
whatsapp.ask_material: Do you have the parts needed (like a hinge, tap or switch), or should the worker bring them?
whatsapp.ask_address: Please send your full address and a nearby landmark.
whatsapp.ask_time_window: By when should it be done?
whatsapp.ask_priority: When the rates come in, how should I order the list: soonest first, cheapest first, or best work first?
whatsapp.card_complete: Thank you! We're now collecting rates from workers nearby.
whatsapp.change_noted: We've noted your change. Workers were contacted with the earlier details. Their rates may change with the new details, but will stay within the range each worker gave.
whatsapp.photo_received: Got the photo, we'll show it to the workers.
whatsapp.no_workers: Sorry, no worker is available for this job in your area right now.
whatsapp.shortlist_visit_title: Will quote after seeing the job:
whatsapp.shortlist_later: {count} more can come after your preferred time (at the bottom of the list).
whatsapp.shortlist_no_photo: These rates are based on the details from your call. Since no photo was sent, the final price after seeing the job may fall within the range the worker gave.
whatsapp.shortlist_footer: Tap *Choose worker* below to book one.
whatsapp.not_chosen_worker: Thanks for your quote. The customer chose another worker this time.
whatsapp.login_code: Your suvidha login code is *{code}*. It works for 10 minutes. Never share it with anyone, not even a worker.
